description: This file defines the AccountsProvider class, which manages account data and balances within a Flutter application, providing state management and data reloading functionalities.

classes.name: AccountsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that provides list of accounts and balance updates, handling data loading and state management.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Static async method to create an AccountsProvider instance and load initial data.

methods.name: loading
methods.description: Getter indicating whether data is currently loading.

methods.name: totalBalance
methods.description: Getter that computes the total balance of all accounts.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Async method to reload account data from the repository.

methods.name: updateBalance
methods.description: Async method to update the balance of a specific account and refresh data.
